_comment: Redistribution rights for non-source binary inputs carried IN THIS
This file is the record, not a switch. make-public-tree.sh used to take
--allow-unlicensed-blobs, which let a caller assert permission that nobody
had obtained -- and a blob published without rights cannot be unpublished.
An entry here has to name the evidence, so 'we have permission' is
something written down and reviewable rather than a flag someone typed.
confirmed    written permission to redistribute in our public tree and
source bundles. Requires source, granted_by, evidence, date.
unconfirmed  no permission established. Excluded from anything published,
and every board that needs it is unbuildable from a public
Redistribution rights for firmware are separate from the GPL: a blob may be
freely usable and still not freely redistributable, and no source archive
See resolved[] for inputs that used to be listed here and no longer are.

resolved.was: patches/bpi-r4-pro/firmware/as21x1x_fw.bin (261,400 bytes), linked into vmlinux via CONFIG_EXTRA_FIRMWARE
resolved.now: an ordinary root filesystem file at /lib/firmware/as21x1x_fw.bin, installed by the aeonsemi-as21xxx-firmware package built from the linux-firmware release pinned in DOWNLOADS.lock.json
resolved.device: AS21010P 10GBASE-T PHY on bpi-r4-pro (the earlier description said Airoha/MaxLinear and 2.5GbE; both were wrong)
resolved.provenance: byte-identical to linux-firmware-20251125/aeonsemi/as21x1x_fw.bin; that release records it in WHENCE as 'Licence: Redistributable. See LICENSE.aeonsemi for details.'
licence_note: LICENSE.aeonsemi grants use and redistribution for devices containing
AEONSEMI silicon, and excludes distribution 'as part of the Linux kernel
or in any other form which would require these files themselves to be
covered by the terms of the GNU General Public License'.
CONFIG_EXTRA_FIRMWARE links the file into vmlinux, which is the excluded
form. It is therefore no longer built in; the firmware is distributed as
a separate file by the upstream firmware package, carrying the upstream
licence with it, with its source and hash recorded in the release lock.
The licence does not affirmatively enumerate which forms are permitted --
it excludes. This entry records what we do and why; the wording used in a
public release is for legal review.
